messages:
andrew_sales: Quick sync — Acme Financial wants a 4-week pilot starting next Monday. They asked for 3 prioritized journeys, success criteria, and any security blockers by EOD Wednesday.

olivia_se: TL;DR their top usecases are: 1) live chat triage (low-latency, streaming), 2) document ingestion + extractive summaries for KYC PDFs, 3) autocomplete for agent UI (snippet suggestions).

devon_soleng: Proposed mapping to endpoints:
- /v1/chat (streaming) -> live triage, model: rwdx-3b or rwdx-4b-quant
- /v1/embeddings -> doc search + semantic retrieval
- /v1/completions -> autocomplete endpoint with short context
We should include a lightweight reranker for summary accuracy.

lina_security: They require SSO (SAML), a filled security questionnaire (SOC2/ISO Qs), and KMS integration with customer-managed keys. Also retention: 90/365 options. Will need clarification: will any PII be posted to hosted logs? @andrew_sales please confirm.

sam_pm: Success metrics we promised to validate:
- median p50 latency < 200ms for streaming chat (first token)
- doc summary F1 > 0.8 on their testset (we'll run evals)
- reduction in agent resolution time by 15% (measured in A/B)
We should commit to evaluation harness and a prompt set by end of week.

andrew_sales: Good. On PII — they said account numbers and SSNs will be redacted on their side, but they may want private deployment later. For pilot we can run hosted with KMS + retention 90d, with PRD stating no raw logs retained.

devon_soleng: For prompts/evals — I'll create 3 canonical prompt templates and a small eval harness (10 seed cases per journey). Example prompt for doc summary:
```
System: You are a concise summarizer for KYC documents.
User: Summarize the following PDF extracts focusing on risk flags and missing fields.
Context: <extracted_text>
```
We'll run automatic metrics (ROUGE/F1) and some human spot checks.

lina_security: Also need answers for these Qs from their questionnaire: data residency, incident notification SLA, and encryption-at-rest details. I can draft boilerplate answers but need exact infra plan (hosted vs private).

olivia_se: Pricing question: they want a committed monthly price if we guarantee dedicated capacity for peak hours. Should we propose dedicated for evenings only, with burst on Hosted? @devon_soleng any ops concerns?

devon_soleng: Ops: mixing Dedicated + Hosted is fine if we route by policy. We'll estimate committed GPUs for 99th percentile load; need their expected concurrent sessions number. If they want a hard SLA for p50/p99 we'll recommend Dedicated. I'll put together a conservative cost estimate by EOD tomorrow.

sam_pm: Owners & next steps:
- olivia_se: synthesize prioritized journeys + acceptance criteria (owner)
- devon_soleng: prod endpoints + ops cost estimate
- lina_security: security Q draft + required artifacts
- andrew_sales: confirm PII posture and concurrent sessions
- bench-bot: please post the deploy checklist link and test dataset template

bench-bot: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pilot-checklist (link) :white_check_mark:

olivia_se: I'll share a one-pager to Acme with the three journeys, acceptance tests, and timeline (week 0 kickoff, week 1 ingestion + evals, week 2 integrations, week 3 tuning, week 4 wrap & handoff). Target to send by tomorrow noon.

andrew_sales: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker ping me and I'll escalate to solutions exec. :rocket:

lina_security: one more: they'll ask about pen test window — offer a read-only pen test on staging during week 3. Noted.

devon_soleng: I'll also attach a sample small prompt set and a sample CI job for running the evals. Example CI command:
```
python tests/run_eval.py --model rwdx-4b-quant --cases tests/acme_seed.json
```
olivia_se: Great. Closing loop here — I'll draft the pilot plan and post it in #sales tomorrow.
